name: Hapa Build Journal
purpose: A public-safe, searchable interview format for revisiting Hapa builds: why they were made, what was learned, what remains reusable, what needs improvement, and what evidence validates the account.

questions: What concrete user, workflow, or systems problem made this build worth attempting at that time?
What was intentionally in scope, and what did the prototype deliberately leave unresolved?
What did the team learn from building, testing, or documenting it?
Which components, patterns, cards, contracts, or decisions are still reusable now?
What would you change with current Hapa capabilities, better evidence, or more time?
Which sources validate this account, and what is the correct production/prototype/derived claim class?
What should a future agent retrieve or check before extending this work?
interviewFormat.recordRule: Store source links, answers, claim class, reusable outputs, improvement prompts, and a public-safe change summary. Do not expose private transcripts, credentials, sensitive customer data, or unverified claims.
